newsitem.title: GERMANY: BREMEN COFFEE PRICE GAINS NOMINAL IN DULL MARKET.
newsitem.headline: BREMEN COFFEE PRICE GAINS NOMINAL IN DULL MARKET.

text.p: Price rises in Bremen arabicas by $12-17 on the week per 50 kg fob reflected speculator buying in New York earlier although the market on Friday was down again on profit-taking, traders said.
Roasters were well covered and not interested in purchases during a seasonal coffee market slowdown.
Sporadic buying focused on Dec/Jan shipments.
Differentials payable for Brazilian unwashed arabicas were favourable compared with those of Colombians and Centrals.
Robusta prices were up $3 on the week, with Indonesian second hand prices at $80 cif and Cameroon origins at $79.
